data.text: Olukorede Titilolu, Esq. holds a B.sc degree in Public Administration from Ambrose Alli University, Ekpoma, Bachelor of Laws (LL.B) Degree from Olabisi Onabanjo University (OOU), Ago Iwoye, Ogun State and attended Nigerian Law School, a Master of Business Administration specializing in Human Resources Management from Lagos State University, Ojo, Lagos.

He is a Fellow, Institute of Chartered Mediators and Conciliator (FCMC), Fellow, Institute of Capital Market Registrars (FCMR), Associate, Chartered Institute of Stockbrokers (ACIS) and Associate Member, Chartered Institute of Arbitrators, UK.

His working career cuts across the manufacturing, shipping, construction, consultancy and financial sectors of the Nigerian economy. He joined the services of First Registrars in 2002 and he has actively participated in so many successful public offers and right issues of many quoted companies in the Nigeria Capital Market, such as FirstBank, Zenith Bank, ETI Transnational, Accra, Bank PHB, Vono Plc, Prestige Assurance Plc, IBTC Plc, etc.

Olukorede has attended several courses on Leadership, Management and Corporate Governance both locally and internationally. He is at present Head, Corporate Services Division in First Registrars and Investor Services Limited.
He is happily married with children
